title: 12-Month Fullstack + ML School
designedFor: A motivated adult learner with a day job, new to programming, learning visually, needing repetition.
goal: Fullstack Software Engineer with ML expertise — job-ready for Nigeria AND Canada.

dailyStructure.label: Review
dailyStructure.description: Re-read yesterday's notes OR rewatch a short clip. This fights forgetting.

dailyStructure.label: Lesson
dailyStructure.description: New concept. Watch video first, then read the text/docs.

dailyStructure.label: Practice
dailyStructure.description: Type out every example. Break it. Fix it. Never copy-paste.

dailyStructure.label: Mini-task
dailyStructure.description: A small problem using today's concept.

dailyStructure.label: Log
dailyStructure.description: Write 3 sentences: what you learned, what confused you, what to review tomorrow.

sunday: Rest + 1-hour weekly review. Read your log. Plan Monday.

rules.title: Never skip review.
rules.detail: Forgetting is not failure — not reviewing is.

rules.title: Watch twice.
rules.detail: First time for overview. Second time, pause and do it yourself.

rules.title: Type, don't copy.
rules.detail: Your hands need to learn too.

rules.title: Confusion is good.
rules.detail: Write it down. It means your brain is working.

rules.title: Apply early.
rules.detail: You'll never feel ready. Apply anyway.

notes.heading: Canadian market prep
items: Resume format in Canada is different — 1 page max, no photo, results-focused bullets.
LinkedIn is the #1 job search tool in Canada — optimize it in Week 45.
Target cities: Toronto, Ottawa, Calgary — strong tech sectors.
Job boards: LinkedIn, Indeed Canada, Glassdoor, Workopolis, AngelList (startups).
